headline: Enabling encryption on an existing unencrypted RDS instance requires destroying and recreating it — this will drop the production database.

findings.evidence_ref: Change of `storage_encrypted = false` to `storage_encrypted = true` on an existing aws_db_instance
findings.explanation: AWS does not support modifying storage_encrypted in-place on an existing RDS instance. Terraform will destroy the current database and create a new encrypted one, resulting in data loss unless migrated via snapshot first. The PR description misrepresents this as a one-line configuration fix.
